paragraphs: OD Security North America, a Women-Owned Small Business, is the North American distributor of the SOTER RS Full Body Security Scanning System and a strategic R&D partner to OD Security BV. The company was established in late 2012, is based out of College Station, Texas, and grew its team from the Healthcare and Medical X-Ray industry. The company describes the SOTER RS as a contact-free search procedure with no safety risk to Staff.

Contraband detection for Law Enforcement, Corrections and Community Justice Agencies is the stated market, and the company says the challenges those agencies face constantly increase. OD Security North America says it was awarded a contract by the Texas Department of Criminal Justice to provide SOTER RS Full Body Security Scanning Systems into TDCJ State Prison Facilities. The system can interface directly with a Jail Management System, which the company presents as a way to reduce processing time.

THEIA, the automatic threat recognition software, uses Artificial Intelligence to highlight and identify anomalies in scan images and flag them to the Operator. THEIA was trained on large collections of negative body scan images so that it can recognize anything that should not be part of a full body scan.

quote.text: The challenges facing Law Enforcement, Corrections and Community Justice Agencies constantly increase. The nature and type of contraband continues to change.
